ws_risk_config.content: Risk Config worksheet 'churn_rules_v3'. Ticket counting rule: count Zendesk tickets with status in {open, pending} created in the last 60 days; exclude tickets tagged 'billing-only'. Risk thresholds: HIGH = (>=4 qualifying tickets) OR (RenewalDate within 90 days AND >=2 qualifying tickets); MEDIUM = 2-3 qualifying tickets; LOW = <2 qualifying tickets. Follow-up action rules: HIGH -> send CSM outreach email + create Salesforce 'Churn Save' task due in 3 days; MEDIUM -> create Salesforce 'Check-in' task due in 10 days; LOW -> no action. Always post a quarter summary to #customer-success after actions complete.
